decisions.reason: Directly builds on the firm's airfield lighting control knowledge, giving strong absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve.
Related to surveillance display but requires integrating unfamiliar data sources, so absorptive capacity is moderate but sufficient to keep.
Training program leverages existing airport systems knowledge, though as an adjacent service it has moderate improvement potential.
Airfield ground lighting training is closely tied to core lighting expertise, enabling easy assimilation of feedback and learning.
Collaboration software tool lies outside the firm's electrical equipment knowledge base, limiting its ability to learn from early market results.
Multilateration surveillance requires specialized signal processing and RF knowledge not closely related to existing capabilities, reducing absorptive capacity.
